article.headline: Rockets face the Bucks, look for 5th straight victory
article.description: Houston Rockets (4-0, first in the Western Conference) vs. Milwaukee Bucks (1-3, 12th in the Eastern Conference)
article.title: Rockets face the Bucks, look for 5th straight victory
article.linkText: Rockets face the Bucks, look for 5th straight victory
article.story: Houston Rockets (4-0, first in the Western Conference) vs. Milwaukee Bucks (1-3, 12th in the Eastern Conference) Milwaukee; Wednesday, 8 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Houston seeks to prolong its four-game win streak with a victory over Milwaukee. Milwaukee went 32-50 overall with a 19-22 record at home during the 2025-26 season. The Bucks averaged 25.8 assists per game on 40.8 made field goals last season. Houston went 52-30 overall with a 22-19 record on the road a season ago. The Rockets shot 47.9% from the field and 36.4% from 3-point range last season. INJURIES: Bucks: None listed. Rockets: Marcus Smart: out (forearm), Steven Adams: out (soleus). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
